metadata.method_name: Causal DS-CNN with calibrated prefix SPRT early stopping vs full window and matched confidence threshold
metadata.description: Early-stop keyword spotting on Speech Commands v2 (HF mirror danjacobellis/speech_commands_v2). Energy is MODELLED (E = f*E_full + (1-f)*E_full*m/49, E_full from arXiv 2505.15622). Full per-seed results: results/method_detailed.json. Report: method_report.md.

examples.input: Speech Commands v2 test split, 10 keywords one-vs-rest. Model seed 0, target alpha = beta = 0.001. Compare full window, calibrated SPRT, matched confidence threshold, oracle threshold, decorrelated SPRT and uncalibrated SPRT.
examples.output: Calibrated SPRT: FA=3.02% FR=2.85% mean_prefix_columns=32.11 stop_before_49=72.0% modelled_energy_LPerf_f0.2_uJ=113.4 bound_pass=False. Full window: FA=3.03% FR=2.80% mean_prefix_columns=49.00 stop_before_49=0.0% modelled_energy_LPerf_f0.2_uJ=156.5 bound_pass=False. Energy is MODELLED, not measured.
